message:
Running command: cd /workspace && cat > candidate_trace.json <<'JSON'
[
  {"step":1,"file":"src-vul/opensc/src/tests/fuzzing/fuzz_pkcs15_reader.c","function":"LLVMFuzzerTestOneInput","line":154,"var":"Data/Size","code":"fuzz_add_reader(ctx, Data, Size);","note":"Attacker-controlled bytes become the backing store for the synthetic reader and are later exposed as card file contents."},
  {"step":2,"file":"src-vul/opensc/src/tests/fuzzing/fuzz_pkcs15_reader.c","function":"fuzz_reader_transmit","line":104,"var":"chunk","code":"fuzz_get_chunk(reader, &chunk, &chunk_size);","note":"The fuzz reader returns slices of the attacker input as APDU responses, allowing arbitrary EF data to be supplied to parsers."},
  {"step":3,"file":"src-vul/opensc/src/libopensc/ef-atr.c","function":"sc_parse_ef_atr","line":145,"var":"buf","code":"rv = sc_read_binary(card, 0, buf, size, 0);","note":"EF(ATR) is read from the card into a heap buffer that now contains attacker-controlled bytes from the fuzz reader."},
  {"step":4,"file":"src-vul/opensc/src/libopensc/ef-atr.c","function":"sc_parse_ef_atr_content","line":109,"var":"tag","code":"tag = sc_asn1_find_tag(ctx, buf, buflen, ISO7816_TAG_II_ALLOCATION_SCHEME, &taglen);","note":"The parser searches the attacker-controlled EF.ATR payload for the allocation-scheme tag and forwards the tag body for OID decoding."},
  {"step":5,"file":"src-vul/opensc/src/libopensc/ef-atr.c","function":"sc_parse_ef_atr_content","line":115,"var":"tag/taglen","code":"if(sc_asn1_decode_object_id(tag, taglen, &ef_atr.allocation_oid))","note":"The tag body is interpreted as an ASN.1 OBJECT IDENTIFIER; malformed length/content can drive the decoder into unsafe behavior."},
  {"step":6,"file":"src-vul/opensc/src/libopensc/asn1.c","function":"sc_asn1_decode_object_id","line":798,"var":"inbuf/inlen","code":"sc_asn1_decode_object_id(const u8 *inbuf, size_t inlen, struct sc_object_id *id)","note":"This decoder walks attacker-controlled OID bytes and accumulates subidentifiers without a full bounds-safe representation of the decoded value."}
]
JSON
bash submit.sh /workspace/candidate_trace.json /workspace/candidate_trace.json || true && echo '--- trace written ---' && cat candidate_trace.json
